items.title: Apple faces unprecedented memory cost increases as RAM prices continue to surge, manufacturing bill climbs by $33 billion
items.summary: Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron are facing strong demand for memory from AI data centers, prompting manufacturers to prioritize higher-margin server products and high-bandwidth memory. That shift is tightening supplies of conventional DRAM and NAND flash used in smartphones, laptops, and other consumer devices. The squeeze is also affecting smaller manufacturers, with Fairphone reporting that memory now accounts for nearly 60% of the bill of materials for some of its phones
items.title_original: Apple faces unprecedented memory cost increases as RAM prices continue to surge, manufacturing bill climbs by $33 billion
items.title_en: Apple faces unprecedented memory cost increases as RAM prices continue to surge, manufacturing bill climbs by $33 billion

items.summary_zh: 三星、SK海力士和美光正面临人工智能数据中心对内存的强劲需求，促使制造商优先考虑利润率较高的服务器产品和高带宽内存。这种转变导致智能手机、笔记本电脑和其他消费设备中使用的传统 DRAM 和 NAND 闪存的供应紧张。这种挤压也影响到了规模较小的制造商，Fairphone 报告称，内存现在占其部分手机物料清单的近 60%
